# Visual Creator — Launcher Skill

Thin native doorway. The resolved CURRENT authoritative module is behavioral authority; this launcher carries no duplicate domain policy.

## BINDING

KERNEL = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-141
COMPONENT = Visual Creator / ND-SKILL-VIS-1
ROLE = CHILD
STRUCTURAL_PARENT = nd-launch-true-visual / NAM-141
SLOT = CHILD
IMPLICIT_POLICY = DENY
LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-visual-creator/nd-launch-visual-creator
MANUAL_ALIAS = @ND Visual Creator
ROOT_LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent
STRUCTURAL_PARENT_URI = skills://plugins/nd-true-visual/nd-launch-true-visual

Resolve CURRENT through the stable Kernel unless the active chain already carries a verified binding. Re-resolve after authority mutation, currentness conflict, or recovery. Never select authority from memory, version number, timestamp, branch, or stale provider pointer.

## EXECUTABLE BINDING

Exact callable target: `skills://plugins/nd-visual-creator/nd-launch-visual-creator`.
Manual alias: `@ND Visual Creator`.
Root launcher: `skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent`.
Structural parent launcher: `skills://plugins/nd-true-visual/nd-launch-true-visual`.

Executable cognitive routing MUST use exact CURRENT launcher URIs, not human-readable module names or bare `nd-launch-*` identifiers. Resolve the target URI from the CURRENT StateHead-bound Registry runtime-binding catalog.

Every outbound CHILD / PEER_SERVICE / SUPPORT call carries exact caller/target/owner/return launcher URIs as applicable. RETURN addresses the already-live caller by its exact URI but MUST NOT re-invoke a caller that is still live. Re-entry through an exact launcher URI occurs only when the expected caller/parent is absent and CURRENT task/call/correlation/runtime-generation authority still matches.

If the stored URI and the live plugin Skill catalog disagree, fail closed on name-only invocation, refresh binding/currentness evidence, and surface a material unresolved binding conflict to Automation Agent. Generation remains external capability/route SUPPORT and is not the resolver for internal cognitive identities.

## RUNTIME OWNERSHIP

This launcher executes only beneath its structural parent. The parent remains logically live as task owner or bounded PEER_SERVICE owner while this Child is the current execution focus.

Serialize local sibling Children unless a separately qualified parallel/subagent runtime is explicitly active.

USER_DIRECT intent establishes/re-enters Automation Agent as global root, then routes owner-first through the structural parent to this Child. A request originating from another Supervisor routes to the structural parent directly as bounded PEER_SERVICE; the structural parent decides whether this Child is needed.

RETURN delivers the bounded typed result to the already-live parent and closes this Child call. The Child never acquires the caller's task ownership.

If the parent is unexpectedly absent, restore/re-enter it only when CURRENT A2 runtime state still authorizes the matching task/call/correlation generation. If the branch is stale or superseded, do not resurrect it; retain the late result as evidence and surface material recovery needs to Automation Agent.

## AUTHORITY

Bounded ND visual artifact production under True Visual and current visual governance.
Inherited authority may be narrowed but never expanded by launcher selection.

External route failure: use `references/RECOVERY.md` JIT; recovery preserves the active chain and substantive owner.

# ND Launcher Recovery Reference — Slim v5

Status: BINDING JIT RESOURCE
Load only for a required external/provider failure, ambiguous consequential mutation, or material currentness/control conflict.

Recovery preserves the substantive objective, caller, task owner, authority ceiling, and return target. It never becomes a second task or transfers ownership merely because another capability repairs a route.

## Exact recovery identities
- Generation SUPPORT: `skills://plugins/nd-generation/nd-launch-generation`
- True Memory currentness/persistence peer: `skills://plugins/nd-true-memory/nd-launch-true-memory`
- Automation Agent root: `skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent`
- External Connecting: `skills://plugins/nd-external-connecting/connecting-external-capabilities`

Resolve CURRENT identities from `NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry`. Names, remembered versions, timestamps, filenames and aliases are not execution authority.

## Failure classes
**ROUTE/CAPABILITY FAILURE:** preserve the live call frame and invoke CURRENT Generation SUPPORT. `FAILED_ROUTE != FAILED_CAPABILITY`.

**CURRENTNESS/AUTHORITY FAILURE:** do not use Generation to choose truth; re-resolve StateHead/Registry and use True Memory only when bounded memory/currentness work is required.

**CONTROL FAILURE:** recover exact caller/owner/return URIs from CURRENT runtime state. Escalate a material global control change only through Automation Agent.

## Preserve the call frame
Keep caller/owner/target/return launcher URIs, call kind, objective, authority ceiling, task/call/correlation/runtime-generation identity, and replay/effect identity where present. Reject stale returns.

## Route recovery
Resolve the same logical capability through any CURRENT qualified route whose semantics fit the failed operation. There is no fixed route-count, attempt-count, or recovery-pass ceiling. Continue serialized recovery while another materially distinct authorized route/action can improve completion and real provider/quota/context/cost/runtime constraints permit it.

Use External Connecting only when a missing/new/alternate route must actually be created or newly qualified. Recovery must not fan out duplicate consequential effects.

After a route action, read back consequential state and return the typed result to the already-live original caller without re-invoking it.

## Ambiguous mutation
For timeout/unknown/ambiguous consequential outcomes: **READBACK / RECONCILE FIRST — NEVER BLIND RETRY.** Preserve the same effect/idempotency identity. Retry only when authoritative provider state establishes that the intended effect is absent and a retry remains authorized.

## Stop / block
Stop recovery when the intended capability is restored/completed, no materially distinct justified recovery action remains, or a real authority/safety/provider/quota/context/cost/runtime boundary blocks further progress. Do not stop because an arbitrary numeric pass/route/attempt threshold was reached.
